newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Victorias shuts two loading stations.
newsitem.headline: Victorias shuts two loading stations.

text.p: Victorias Milling Co Inc said on Tuesday it had shut down two of its sugar loading stations due to low sugarcane deliveries.

"The very low turnout of cane deliveries brought about by the crisis in the company as well as the industry has therefore compelled the company to suspend its transloading operations," Victorias said in a statement.
The two stations which were used by sugar farmers to transport their produce to Victorias mills was costing Victorias at least 40,000 pesos every month just to rent the cranes.
But the quantity of cane being delivered had been only 500 tonnes each week, way below the required tonnage of at least 1,000 tonnes per week to offset the operating costs, it added.

Victorias recently asked for a 90-day debt moratorium for its 4.423 billion peso outstanding loans with domestic financial institutions due to cashflow problem brought about by the recent downturn in the sugar industry.
